caption:
Global Metadata: A contemplative Turkish Sufi piece, 64 BPM, meditative and breathy. Centered on the ney (a long reed end-blown flute) with its warm, breathy, haunting tone, accompanied by a slow deep percussion and a soft string drone. The ney plays a slow, ornamented, spiritual melody with a flowing breathy quality, the percussion provides a slow heartbeat pulse, and the piece builds gently before a quiet, reverent ending. Production profile: close, hushed Sufi recording, warm breathy ney tone, deep resonant percussion, studio mastering with generous dynamic range.

Vocal Details: No vocals at all. Purely instrumental. Do not add any singing, humming, or voice.

Arrangement: Intro, a slow deep percussion pulse and a soft string drone establish a meditative mood. Section one, the ney enters with a slow ornamented spiritual melody, warm and breathy. Section two, the ney melody unfolds with the percussion heartbeat. Section three, the music builds gently in intensity. Outro, a quiet reverent ending and a soft fade.
